$comment: What svelte-treeview takes from @keenmate/web-components-core. Checked by `npm run check:core-sync` (scripts/check-core-sync.mjs); the why + how is docs/CORE-SYNC.md. `baseline` = the core commit the local copy was last synced / reviewed against. identical = byte-for-byte (line endings / trailing whitespace aside) — any difference is drift. adapted = copied with documented local edits (see `note`) — flagged when core changed the file since `baseline`. mirror = hand-ported behaviour, no shared file — flagged when the listed core sources changed since `baseline`. After a re-sync or review, bump `baseline` to the core commit you compared against.

groups.name: logging
groups.description: Core logger (SPEC §12.1 / §12.3): createLoggers, page-wide window.components.logging, perf logger.

groups.name: environment
groups.description: Theme context (SPEC §12.10), viewport / device / breakpoints, element size, motion level (SPEC §12.16).

groups.name: helpers
groups.description: dom / global helpers the vendored modules import; animate-out = row animation (docs/PLAN-row-animation.md).

groups.name: controller-facade
groups.description: The public controller (SPEC §12.34): createControllerFacade builds the frozen `controller` every ctx carries over the TreeEngine (core/tree-controller.ts) — same as web-treeview's TreeViewController.

groups.name: pointer-drag
groups.description: Drag and drop (SPEC §12.28): core createPointerDrag drives the tree's ONE pointer drag (mouse / pen / touch — threshold, long press, scroll lock, hit test through shadow roots, auto-scroll, Escape, the swallowed trailing click) via TreeEngine.attachPointerDrag; same as web-treeview's renderer. scroll-container + ghost-click are its imports; scroll-container also backs scrollToPath({ containerScroll }) (was a hand-rolled findScrollableAncestor).

groups.name: a11y
groups.description: ARIA tree (REVIEW B22, same as web-treeview's renderer): createActiveDescendant (SPEC §12.25, ARIA-only — the focused role="tree" .stv__container owns aria-activedescendant, the tree keeps its own keys) + announce() (SPEC §12.23, the page's one polite live region: search results, drop outcome, refused drop). create-id is active-descendant's import. Identical since the core rc26 re-sync (2026-11-24) — the callSafely/runSafely edit is gone.

groups.name: locale
groups.description: Labels + page-wide locale (SPEC §12.24): flat <elementType>.<name> keys; createLabels = labels prop → the tree's translateCallback → window.components.locale.translateCallback → the flat page dictionary labels['svelte-treeview.<key>'] → English. src/lib/core/labels.ts is the seam.

groups.name: icons
groups.description: Icons (SPEC §12.33): renderIcon + ICON_CSS — node icons (TreeEngine.renderNodeIconHtml) and context-menu item icons: markup → built-in name → the tree's renderIconCallback → window.components.renderIconCallback → icon-font <i class="stv__icon …"> → text. The `component` option (core 7e87b5f) names the tree, whose host is a <div>.

groups.name: search
groups.description: Search folding (SPEC §12.11): normalizeSearchText is the FlexSearch `normalize` step of the built-in index (src/lib/ltree/flex.ts) — lowercase, diacritics stripped, ł → l, ß → ss, æ → ae; the same folding as web-treeview / web-multiselect (REVIEW §4).

groups.name: virtual window
groups.description: Virtual scroll range math (SPEC §12.26): computeVirtualRange drives TreeEngine.vsRange (rows in view + virtualScrollOverscan, clamped) — the same math as web-treeview (REVIEW §4). Only the pure function is used; createVirtualWindow is not (Svelte renders the window).

groups.name: css values
groups.description: Reading CSS tokens (REVIEW §4): readCssDurationMs (is --stv-row-animation-duration above 0s → row animation on) and readScrollBehavior (--stv-scroll-behavior → scrollToPath's default behavior).

groups.name: vendored tests
groups.description: Core's unit tests for the vendored modules.
groups.note: `// @vitest-environment jsdom` docblock (this repo's vitest default is node); theme.test.ts also drops the BlissElement cases. motion.test.ts is NOT vendored (needs BlissElement) — e2e/motion-level.spec.ts covers motion. Re-synced 2026-11-24 to core c2f5f83 (rc26 + D-NC-30 verbs) (theme.test / render-icon.test keep their trimmed local copies — they test unchanged behaviour without BlissElement).

groups.name: actions
groups.description: Clickable-item model + activation runner behind the context menu (src/lib/core/menu.ts).
groups.note: coreLog(source,'UI',…) → the tree's uiLogger; ComponentContext = { controller } (no host element); resolve.test.ts: console spies → uiLogger, jsdom docblock. See src/lib/vendor/actions/README.md. Re-synced 2026-11-24 to core c2f5f83 (rc26 + D-NC-30 verbs) + c2f5f83: getMenuChildren → loadMenuChildren (public export renamed too); cf20659: runAction option emitAction → dispatchAction.

groups.name: shortcut
groups.description: Keyboard shortcut parse / match (SPEC §12.12) + isTypingTarget — context-menu item shortcuts and the tree keydown guard.
groups.note: Only the environment import path differs (../core/environment/environment.js). Re-synced 2026-11-24 to core c2f5f83 (rc26 + D-NC-30 verbs) (shortcutKeycaps → getShortcutKeycaps, isEnabled(event)).

groups.name: tooltip action
groups.description: use:tooltip mirrors core createTooltip (portal, autoUpdate, followCursor, theme inherit) on @floating-ui/dom.
groups.note: baseline estimated from the local file's last change (2026-10-13).

groups.name: info popover
groups.description: nodeTitleOverflow='info' full-label popover mirrors core createPopover (+ shouldCloseOnScroll).
groups.note: baseline = just before core's 2026-11-07 scroll-close change, which parity.md lists as 'to mirror' (svelte closes on any page scroll).

groups.name: loader hook
groups.description: core/loader.ts reads the page-wide loader hook core's renderLoader() publishes (SPEC §12.14).
groups.note: Reviewed 2026-11-24 (core rc26: RenderLoaderCallback → RenderLoadingCallback type name only): reads renderLoadingCallback (+ the pre-rc19 renderLoaderCallback), default .stv__loader. The loadingPlaceholder snippet stays first and never needs window.components.

groups.name: global API
groups.description: global-api.ts publishes window.components['svelte-treeview'] in core registerComponent()'s shape (SPEC §12.3).
groups.note: Reviewed 2026-11-24 (core rc26): publishPageLogging / PageLoggingControls renames; publishIconHook also publishes window.components.icons (the page-wide icon map — typed on Window). register also publishes window.components.renderIconCallback (publishIconHook) and window.components.locale / .security (publishLocaleHooks).

groups.name: context menu
groups.description: Context menu = core openMenu() (SPEC §12.13): rendering, submenus (lazy too), positioning, dismiss, the WAI-ARIA keyboard, the phone sheet / drawer (menuPresentation / menuSide). Tree.svelte opens it; a contextMenu snippet fills its custom-menu element.
groups.note: Only the /actions import paths differ (../../actions/ — svelte's adapted copy). menu/inputs.ts is NOT vendored (BlissElement input rows): Tree.svelte has menuPresentation / menuSide props instead. Re-synced 2026-11-24 to core c2f5f83 (rc26 + D-NC-30 verbs) (closeCallback; the phone sheet is a modal session). Vendored 2026-11-21 (was a hand-written Svelte mirror, baseline e6a0771).

groups.name: menu helpers
groups.description: What core openMenu() imports: its stylesheet, overlay (one-open-at-a-time, sheet session / chrome, scroll lock, keyboard inset, phone Back), positioning (anchor, scroll close, containing block, theme inherit), dom (active element, direction). Since core rc26: overlay/modal-session (the phone sheet is modal) + its dom/focus-trap and dom/z-index.
